items.text:
The truth of the self-conscious individual lies not in its immediate  certainty,  but  in  the  dialectical  movement  of  its becoming.  Consciousness,  in  its  pursuit  of  knowledge,  initially assumes that its object is something external and independent. Yet,  through  the  labour  of  experience,  it  discovers  that  this object  is  not  truly  separate  but  _____  (76)  by  consciousness itself.
The apparent duality of subject and object is thus sublated in the dialectic,  revealing  that  knowledge  is not the passive reception of an external truth but an active process in which consciousness shapes and _____ (77) its own reality.
This  movement  unfolds  through  a  series  of  contradictions,  in which  each  stage  of  consciousness,  believing  itself  to  have attained certainty, encounters its own inadequacy. The master-slave dialectic exemplifies this: self-consciousness seeks  recognition  from  another,  yet  in asserting its dominance over the other, it paradoxically _____ (78) its own freedom.

items.text: For  many  young  professionals,  choosing  a  career  is  no  longer just  about  earning  a  salary-it's  about  finding meaning in what they  do.  Some  are  drawn  to high-paying jobs, while others feel more  (81)_________ working in fields that align with their personal  values.  This  growing  divide  between  passion  and paycheck  has  led  to  tough  decisions  for  many.  While financial stability  is  important,  ignoring  one's  true  interests  can  lead  to long-term (82)_________. Experts suggest that a balanced approach  is  possible.  One  can  pursue  a  stable  job  and  still nurture  their  passions  through  part-time  work,  volunteering,  or creative outlets. However, such a path requires careful (83)_________.  Making  impulsive  career  shifts  without  planning can lead to regret. It's important to evaluate not just income, but also growth, purpose, and job (84)_________. After all, the goal is not  just  to  survive-but  to  build  a  life  that  is  both  secure  and (85)_________.
